description: CrlChecker documents re-parsing the CRL DER on every check_revocation call as a v0.1 limitation. OcspChecker has the same behavior (re-parses response_der on every call) but the limitation is absent from OcspChecker's doc comment. Inconsistent documentation will confuse users reasoning about performance in chains with many certs.
title: OcspChecker: re-parse on every call not documented in Limitations
